policy.policy: Optional --spectral-joins, default off. Replace only the coarse eight-band term at same-vowel center joins where both old FEAT windows are reliably voiced. Full native contiguous transitions still cost zero.
policy.descriptor: 40 ms centered window, wholly inside the aligned source vowel; centered PCM RMS >= .003; sample-rate-adjusted .97 at 16 kHz preemphasis; Hann; radix-2 power FFT; 24 triangular mel filters 80 Hz to min(7600 Hz, .95 Nyquist); log filter energy floored relative to total power at 1e-10; orthonormal DCT c1..12, discard energy c0.
policy.cost: RMS distance of 12 cepstral coefficients times 12, capped at 60. Invalid or unavailable envelope keeps old spectral term. No tuning after corpus results.
policy.cache: Per request, by absolute source-center sample; no shared mutable bank cache. No audio editing or pack format changes.
policy.validation: Signal fixtures including gain/DC invariance, silence guards, spectral identity and separation; all existing native tests; default exact comparisons; nine-voice old and vocabulary/book corpus, then new text after fixed policy.
policy.limitations: ASR and phone diagnostics do not establish human intelligibility.

validation.decision: Rejected; optional fine spectral joins remain isolated and uninstalled.
validation.reason: No consistent benefit across independent diagnostics or fresh speech. Same-vowel fine spectral distance did not improve the general corpus or both reading passages.

book_passages: Alice chapter VI: three paragraphs, 207 reference words
The Time Machine chapter V: three paragraphs, 381 reference words

limitation: Comparative word and canonical-phone errors are not human-listening intelligibility percentages. Default outputs were byte-identical; prototype not installed or released.
